name: Itapi Prime
description: Itapi Prime was a prosperous planet in the Itapi Prime system of the Core Worlds near Coruscant. In 3 BBY, it was firmly loyal to the Galactic Empire. A significant amount of trade from the planet used to pass through Calderos Station.
